texts.en:
Our growing industry is ravenous for raw materials, and we need to increase our supply of £minerals£ Minerals. This is done by [GetBuildingGrowing] £mining_station£ Mining Stations above £planet£ Planets and asteroids with Mineral deposits, or by building Mining Districts on the surface of one of our inhabited planets.

As both stations and £building£ Buildings cost £energy£ Energy Credits to maintain, we need to establish an ample supply of this resource as well. Energy Credits are produced by Generator Districts on the surface of our inhabited planets. They can also be acquired by Mining Stations built over planets, asteroids or suns with Energy Credit deposits.
